summary: Ran focused supplier GHG permission regression (backend + UI) against live preview URL. Supplier restrictions for Process/Flaring/Custom Fuel are enforced in supplier endpoints and correctly reflected in supplier UI; parent/admin UI still shows broader behavior. Found two critical backend/auth issues.

critical.issue: Supplier direct POST with is_custom_fuel=true returns 500 instead of controlled 4xx rejection. Backend log shows AttributeError in create_emission_record: EmissionRecordCreate has no attribute category_id.
CORS preflight responds with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*' instead of explicit trusted origin (frontend URL), violating requested explicit-origin auth behavior.

action_items: Fix /api/emissions create path to avoid AttributeError on category_id access (align request model vs router usage) and return policy-safe 4xx for forbidden supplier custom-fuel attempts.
Adjust auth CORS configuration to use explicit allowlist origins for /api/auth/login preflight (no wildcard for trusted-origin flow).
Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_supplier_ghg_permission_gating_iter32.py and supplier/admin /ghg add-emission UI checks after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: modules/emissions/router.py create_emission_record currently accesses record_data.category_id although EmissionRecordCreate does not guarantee that attribute, causing 500 in supplier direct-post path.
Supplier gating implementation in supplier_assessment router + ghg_submission_service correctly blocks Process/Flaring/Custom Fuel when permissions are false.
Frontend supplierScopeAccess gating and EmissionEntryForm behavior correctly hide restricted categories and custom fuel toggle for supplier without leaking restriction to admin UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Supplier UI verified on /ghg/scope1: category options = Fugitive/Mobile/Stationary only; Process and Flaring absent; use-custom-fuel toggle absent. Admin UI verified on /ghg/scope1: category options include Process Emissions and use-custom-fuel toggle visible after selecting Stationary Combustion. Backend pytest run: 7 passed, 2 failed (500 on /api/emissions custom-fuel direct post; CORS wildcard origin).
rca of the issue: Repro 1: login as supplier, POST /api/emissions with scope1 Stationary Combustion and is_custom_fuel=true -> 500. Backend traceback points to modules/emissions/router.py create_emission_record reading record_data.category_id, but request model instance lacks that attribute. Mitigation: make category_id optional in model or safe-get in router before policy checks, and return 400/403 instead of crashing. Repro 2: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with trusted Origin=https://ghg-reporting-hub.preview.emergentagent.com returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' (not explicit). Mitigation: tighten CORS middleware config to explicit origins with credentials-enabled behavior.
